sources.text: Welcome to Jin Lab Our Research About The Jin lab focuses on discovering the mechanisms underlying the development, maintenance and function of the nervous system using the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans and mice. Our ultimate goal is to connect the studies of basic mechanisms to the understanding of human neurological disorders and neuronal repair.
